skills.name: Poké Pad
skills.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn’t have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

skills.name: Boss’s Orders
skills.text: Switch in 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.

skills.name: Crispin
skills.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Energy cards of different types, reveal them, and put 1 of them into your hand. Attach the other to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

skills.name: Unfair Stamp
skills.text:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.

skills.name: Judge
skills.text: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.

skills.name: Buddy-Buddy Poffin
skills.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon with 70 HP or less and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

skills.name: Run Away Draw
skills.text: Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

skills.name: Night Stretcher
skills.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

skills.name: Lillie's Determination
skills.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards. If you have exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, draw 8 cards instead.

skills.name: Rosa's Encouragement
skills.text:
You can use this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.

Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

skills.name: Crushing Hammer
skills.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.

skills.name: Ultra Ball
skills.text:
You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.

Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

skills.name: Risky Ruins
skills.text: Whenever any player puts a Basic non-{D} Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

skills.name: Recon Directive
skills.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.

attacks.name: Phantom Dive
attacks.text: Put 6 damage counters on your opponent’s Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
